punchline: Students who wrote the quiz questions were rated smarter than those who had to answer them, though chance picked the roles.
thirty_sec: In a 1977 Stanford study, students were randomly made questioners or contestants in a quiz; contestants and observers rated the questioners as more knowledgeable, mistaking a role for a trait.
question: Whose behavior did you last read as a character flaw, when you knew little about their position?
key_contrast: You see the person, they see the position.
